facts.fact: 周四早晨他补觉，再睁眼手机显示 9:01。
facts.anchor: I drag my pillow over my head and close my eyes again, surprised to fall back to sleep and see 9:01 on my phone when I wake again.

facts.fact: Skillett Creek 是 Mama Tanner 与 Ms. Angie 的点子：把 Skillett 变成目的地。
facts.anchor: She and Ms. Angie, Jody’s mom, came up with the idea of using a piece of land on the property boundary between the two ranches and turning Skillett into a destination.

facts.fact: 他的 F-350 定制电蓝涂装，想低调都难。
facts.anchor: My F-350 is big and noisy, custom-painted electric blue, and I couldn’t be inconspicuous in it if I tried.

facts.fact: 他偷看 Ashton 教 Emmy 骑马，心想那可能是她将来的女儿。
facts.anchor: Ashton teaching a little girl to ride, wide smiles on both of their faces. That could be her daughter someday.

facts.fact: Bunny 背包是网上买的，Harriet 见了哭了。
facts.anchor: “Internet,” Ashton says nonchalantly. “Knew Bunny would be coming out with us today, didn’t wanna risk losing him. Harriet cried when I showed her.”

facts.fact: 因 Emmy 他决心收拾自己、尽早安定。
facts.anchor: She makes me all the more determined to clean up my act and settle down sooner rather than later.

facts.fact: 约好十二点半回马厩碰头带她们吃午饭。
facts.anchor: That idea seems to satisfy Ashton, and she nods. “Meet us back here at twelve-thirty?”

facts.fact: Emmy 在引导下把苹果片喂给 Perry。
facts.anchor: Perry nudges Emmy’s fingers gently before taking the offered apple slice and crunching it between her teeth.
